pattern_name: Binary Not on PATH: Locate via dpkg -L Pattern (2026-06)
summary: When a tool isn't on PATH in this VM (e.g., dfrotz in /usr/games), locate it via dpkg -L and run with an absolute path; also verify whether required story/data files are actually installed.

evidence.output: ii  frotz  2.53+dfsg-1  amd64  interpreter of Z-code story-files
prints usage header containing "FROTZ V2.53" (long --version flag not supported)

recommended_mitigation: Use dpkg -l to confirm the package is installed, even if command -v fails.
List installed files via dpkg -L and invoke the binary with its absolute path under /usr/games/.
Search for required story/data files; supply your own Hitchhiker .z3/.z5/.z8/.zblorb assets when none are bundled.
Invoke dfrotz with -v or run a story file directly, since --version is not a supported long flag.
